$comment: Complete operator briefs filed with --operatorTask skip prepare only after the shared prepare section validator plus Done when/Acceptance, Edge cases and we:-qualified scope checks. Cascade: standard enabled=true/maxPriority=P0 → platform build.operatorTask → tool build.operatorTask. Each leaf source is logged by policy-cascade. maxPriority is the highest allowed priority class (P0 allows all classes). Disabled filing leaves the card unstamped; disabled build admission holds operator cards for prepare even if previously stamped. Operator-task treatment (post-build steps, the filing stamp, an explicit P0) requires operatorTask: true plus a valid operatorInstruction record whose actor is an OPERATOR_LOGINS login. enabled and maxPriority apply to every card's explicit priority, at filing and in the build queue. Post-build steps require that record, enabled=true, an enabled policy leaf and the corresponding card field. Edge-load and live-proof steps are off for every card (planOperatorPostBuild never emits them) until operator-task authority is verified; only the report step is composed. edgeClones maps allowlisted names to workspace-relative or ~/ paths.
